steps.en: Install it into any Python environment
steps.zh: 装进任意 Python 环境

steps.en: Point DSPy at a model via a LiteLLM model string
steps.zh: 用 LiteLLM 模型字符串指定一个模型

steps.en: Declare the task as typed input -> output, not a prompt
steps.zh: 声明带类型的输入→输出，而不是写提示词

steps.en: Builds and sends the actual prompt, parses typed output back
steps.zh: 自动拼出并发送真正的提示词，把输出解析回带类型字段

steps.en: Write a scoring metric, then compile against a train set
steps.zh: 写好打分指标，对着训练集编译

steps.en: Searches instructions & demos that maximize your metric, keeps the best
steps.zh: 在指令与示范样例中搜索，保住指标最高的组合

value.en: Prompts become compiled artifacts — when you swap models, rerun the optimizer instead of hand-editing
value.zh: 提示词成了编译产物——换模型时重跑优化器，而不是手写重调

sources: docs/docs/getting-started/gepa-optimization.md (optimizer = dspy.GEPA(metric=haiku_metric, reflection_lm=reflection_lm, auto="light"); optimized_haiku_bot = optimizer.compile(haiku_bot, trainset=train, valset=val))
